name: Copper sulfate; chemical reaction process; at processing plant
description: This unit process is a cradle-to-gate dataset of production of 1 kg dicalcium phosphate in the US.

processDocumentation.geographyDescription: Represents production at the national level.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Copper sulfate is 25% copper and 75 % was assumed to be sulfuric acid.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Not complete. Some mineral feed ingredients were not available in the SimaPro LCI databases. Than the  model of the unavailable chemical was created using the calculated mass of each reactant necessary to produce one kilogram of product. Energy and water requirements for production of copper sulfate and land use are a data gap.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Only material input data were included in modeling.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: See Copper Development Association Inc. (2016). The unit process was created based on material input data. Copper sulfate contains 25% of copper metal.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Model was created based on the expert advise. Minerals are used in small amouts in pig diets. Some mineral feed ingredients were not available in the US-EI database. If this was the case, the model of the unavailable chemical was created using the calculated mass of each reactant necessary to produce one kilogram of product.
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data was collected during an ongoing project from 2013 through 2015.

sources.name: Development of Life Cycle Inventory data for U.S. Swine Production Scenarios

reviews.details: University of Arkansas swine dataset mapped to USLCI technosphere flows and FEDEFL elementary flows for publication on the Federal LCA Commons. Review covers mapping crosswalks, cutoff flows, and export structure.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.

dataSetOwner.name: University of Arkansas Office for Sustainability
